about: Human-edited list of what this project installs and why. The AI never edits this file. After the owner changes it, the owner runs `node scripts/lock-manifest.mjs`, reviews the diff of skills-manifest.lock.json, and commits both.

audit_levels.full: SKILL.md and every script/hook read by a person or agent; companion docs pattern-scanned for commands and network calls
audit_levels.partial: SKILL.md or scripts read only in part. Installing needs an explicit owner approval (field partialAuditApproved, or --accept-partial-audit=<name>)

entries.name: grill-with-docs
entries.use: Interview that sharpens a plan; writes GLOSSARY.md and ADRs

entries.name: grilling
entries.use: The interview primitive grill-with-docs calls

entries.name: domain-modeling
entries.use: Glossary/ADR discipline grill-with-docs calls

entries.name: to-spec
entries.use: Turn the agreed conversation into a spec (we add required sections, see agent-rules.md)

entries.name: to-tickets
entries.use: Split a spec into vertical-slice tickets

entries.name: handoff
entries.use: Hand work to a fresh session (path overridden to docs/development/handoffs/)

entries.name: prototype
entries.use: Throwaway prototype to answer one question (Answer Replay spike)

entries.name: wait-what
entries.use: Ask the agent to re-explain in simple technical English with our glossary terms

entries.name: writing-for-agents
entries.use: Style guide for writing skills, AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md

entries.name: research
entries.use: Primary-source research into a file (IELTS format facts, library docs). Spawns one background agent

entries.name: impeccable
entries.partialAuditApproved: 2026-11-12: owner chose Impeccable as the main design skill. Read: SKILL.md in full, craft-floor.md in full, parts of hooks/audit/harden/live-setup, launcher and engine checksum logic; engine binary hash verified independently; installer and hook behaviour observed in a sandbox. NOT read: most reference/*.md, Rust engine source.
entries.use: Main design skill: shape, critique, audit, polish, harden, adapt; design detector for CI
humanSteps: Enabling the design hook runs a downloaded binary after every UI edit, outside model approval. Only the owner approves: `sh .claude/skills/impeccable/scripts/impeccable hooks on` (Claude) and `/hooks` trust (Codex).
Set DO_NOT_TRACK=1 in the environment and keep "telemetry": false in .impeccable/config.json. Never run `impeccable auth login`.

entries.name: validate-ielts-content
entries.use: Validate content items (runs tools/validate-content.mjs)

entries.name: property-based-testing
entries.use: Property tests for invariants (timestamps, route-ends-at-answer, scoring)

entries.name: ponytail
entries.use: Smallest-complete-change discipline (level full). Plugin hooks and band deliberately not installed

entries.name: tdd
entries.use: Test-first loop for pure logic at agreed seams

entries.name: implement
entries.use: Build a spec/ticket with tdd, then code-review (agent/* branches only)

entries.name: codebase-design
entries.use: Deep-module vocabulary tdd refers to. DESIGN-IT-TWICE spawns sub-agents: counts toward the cap

entries.name: diagnosing-bugs
entries.use: Feedback-loop-first debugging (audio/route sync bugs); includes a human-in-the-loop script template

entries.name: code-review
entries.use: Standards + Spec review of a diff (max 2 sub-agents)

entries.name: principle-prove-it-works
entries.use: Verify the real artifact, not a proxy

entries.name: blast-radius
entries.use: What a change could break elsewhere, proven by running code

entries.name: pr
entries.use: PR body: summary, before/after evidence, one-way/two-way door, blast radius

entries.name: verify-user-flow
entries.use: Drive the real app: mobile, desktop, RTL, keyboard, exam-mode rules

entries.name: create-verification-skill
entries.use: Run once after the first slice runs: generates verify-ielts-app. Adapted copy of pstack's (see SOURCES.md)

entries.name: retro
entries.use: Retrospective: improve the agent environment after a session. Reads local session logs

entries.name: ielts-security-review
entries.use: Full security review before public release (owner decision)

entries.name: to-questionnaire
entries.use: Questionnaire for an IELTS teacher, Arabic reviewer or lawyer

entries.name: setup-pre-commit
entries.use: Husky + lint-staged + Prettier. Only if the stack is Node/TypeScript

entries.name: show-me-your-work
entries.use: Decision log for long unattended runs

entries.name: wayfinder
entries.use: Map a very large planning effort as decision tickets

entries.name: improve-codebase-architecture
entries.use: After the first slice: architecture review as an HTML report (writes to the temp dir, tries to open it)

entries.name: differential-review
entries.use: Security diff review once a baseline exists; patterns are smart-contract flavoured

entries.name: supply-chain-risk-auditor
entries.use: Dependency risk audit. Its scripts query osv.dev, npm registry, deps.dev, scorecard (sends package names)

rejected.reason: implement-spec runs parallel sub-agents and merges without a human; the others are not needed (grill-me is covered by grill-with-docs; setup is replaced by docs/agents/*; git-guardrails is replaced by our fixed hook). Not audited beyond their descriptions.
Not needed; band-import reads past Claude Code transcripts and the band has an optional webhook.
English-only editing rules could alter calibrated IELTS passages; no Arabic support.
ML training on a GPU; idea adopted instead (protected measurement files).
Marketing-site builder with a 10-minute Stop hook; Impeccable is the single design skill.
Impeccable is the design skill; our E2E is likely TypeScript Playwright.
